1) in early embryos, the duration of the DNA synthetic phase is very short, and 2) in early embryos the replication checkpoint is not functional, and 3) in early embryos DNA damage checkpoints are not functional.

DNA synthesis in early embryos is regulated in a cell cycle-independent manner, that is, it is independent of the cell cycle machinery.
